ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in the Minnesota fraud scandal, including the suspension of thousands of borrowers and the freezing of federal child care funds
questions: How did the alleged fraud occur?
What programs and funding were affected?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough financial analysis of the Minnesota fraud scandal could reveal key insights into the entities and individuals involved, as well as the programs and funding affected. This investigation could lead to further allegations and suspensions.
